headline: 737 fixtures make this the book's second-biggest sport, and 95% of those players have NO world ranking - fast circuits (Czech Liga Pro, TT Elite, Setka, TT Cup) run on internal ratings only. A self-maintained points-Elo is mandatory, not optional.

verified.coverage: THE single best free source: live fixtures (/Matches/nearest/en), player ratings + career W/L + birth year (/Players/en), per-tournament set records, an explicit H2H compare endpoint, and session day-periods that make intra-session fatigue directly modelable.
verified.rate_limit: none observed in 15 rapid calls; self-throttle 1/s

verified.coverage: per-set POINT scores for Liga Pro CZ (608), Setka (1180), TT Cup archives 2022 - 2024-06-09. Historical training corpus, NOT a live fixture feed (current TT feed returns WTT only).

blocked.detail: NO OFFICIAL WEBSITE EXISTS - NXDOMAIN on every plausible domain. Only facebook.com/ligaprocz + YouTube. For Liga Pro / TT Elite there is no first-party feed at all.
tt-cup.com has a broken TLS chain even with the proxy CA - unfetchable
scores24.live, oddspedia, betsapi, aiscore, tabletennisdaily ALL return 200 serving a Cloudflare challenge body. Status-code checks would mark all five as live.

key_findings: Model at POINT level: Bo5-to-11 makes match probability a steep convex function of per-point win prob (0.55/point ~ 0.85/match). Only a point model prices all markets consistently.
H2H is unusually strong here - the same 8-12 player pools meet 10-50 times. It beats the rating prior after ~8-10 meetings.
Intra-session fatigue is real and systematically underpriced: players play 4-6 matches in 2-3h round-robin sessions. The Setka API exposes session day-periods directly.
Setka's 'Paris/Tokyo/Rio locations' are branded TIME-SLOT channels, not cities. Do not model as venue.
Residual edge concentrates in: session fatigue, late-session retirement risk, and stale ratings on new circuit entrants - all recoverable from the Setka API.
Serve/receive stats DO NOT EXIST for fast circuits - no point-by-point serve tags. WTT/ITTF only.
